narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -9.77 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.1728-0.1771 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 0.1785; the first objective pays 0.56R at 0.1716.

plan.triggerRule: footprint abs fired sell in short direction at the zone (absorption inside the zone)
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.1785 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 R 0.56 < 1.5 — reward does not pay the risk

athena_oracle.verdict: Cautious bearish lean 45/100 — squeeze fuel overhead, whales offering

factors.detail: long liq $1.5M -3.2% below · short liq $4.7M +2.5% above
